name: What is the process for valuing my current home in a trade-in program?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for valuing my current home in a trade-in program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The valuation process typically involves a professional assessment of your property's condition, features, and recent comparable sales in your local market. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution will help facilitate this assessment. This evaluation determines the offer for your home. As part of process clarity, you'll receive a detailed explanation of how the valuation was reached, ensuring transparency in the proposed trade-in value, which is crucial for clients in areas like Coral Gables or Pinecrest.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your home's value is assessed by a professional evaluation of its condition, features, and local comparable sales. We provide a transparent explanation of the valuation.
